description: This PHP source file defines the class `ProspectFormBase`, which provides functionalities for managing prospect forms, including duplicate checking, building HTML forms, rendering form bodies, and handling save operations within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: ProspectFormBase
classes.description: A class encapsulating form-related operations such as duplicate checking, form rendering, and save handling for prospects in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: checkForDuplicates
methods.description: Checks for duplicate prospects based on name and email fields by constructing and executing a dynamic SQL query.

methods.name: buildTableForm
methods.description: Builds and returns an HTML table form displaying prospect duplicates for user selection.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive HTML form for editing prospect details with address and contact information.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Creates a simplified HTML form for prospect data entry or editing.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML form for creating or editing a prospect, including headers and submission buttons.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles the process of saving prospect data from POSTed form data, including duplicate handling and redirect logic.
